actions.action: Reapply issue #52 item 3: add next_action dependencies PER ACTION with no inherited global default, each referencing an existing observation key, each with fixture-specific positive and negative tests.
prerequisites: NS-032 merged - static.repository and resolved sources are on main, enforced by build.py reading the schema
DEC-026 disposition 5: per action, no inherited global default, each dependency names an existing observation key, each fixture carries positive and negative tests for its own edge

A human chooses, on issue #52, between the two forms recorded there on 2026-09-04: (i) fixture 08's edge names the inputs the action honestly consumes, which forces its computed.freshness from UNKNOWN to CURRENT and changes the sealed scenario; or (ii) fixture 08's edge names ci_conclusion and pages_status so the scenario is untouched, which asserts that a local authoring action consumes CI - the oracle's answer written into the artifact. Either choice pre-decides fixture 08; DEC-033 records why no third form was found.
evidence_required: No dependency value is assigned in build.py's base() or otherwise inherited by a fixture it was not authored for
Every fixture carries a positive and a negative test for its own edge
A test proving a dependency naming a non-existent observation key fails
stop_conditions: One constant is assigned to more than one fixture - that is exactly what #57 reverted
The edge changes which resume_decision is defensible on any fixture - it is not scored, and the edge must not smuggle it back
Oracles are edited by the author who wrote the fixtures
